performance.verdict: No paid channel has ever launched; 5 overdue milestones block all revenue.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages all missed their 2026-07-31 deadline — 31 days overdue with no completion recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting missed 2026-08-01 go-live — 30 days overdue; $0 spend and 0 leads across all 28 days confirm campaigns never started.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on 5 of the last 7 days (Aug 24–30), down from a mid-August peak of 9 — the only active channel is now effectively dark.
GHL shows 111 contacts and 7 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline exists but is producing no consults, likely because no new paid traffic is feeding it.
GA4 sessions, Search Console clicks, and IG reach are all 0 for the full 45-day series — no organic web presence is measurable, consistent with site not yet live.

suggestions.text: Escalate Pre-Launch Stack Test and site go-live to Nacer immediately — these are the hard blockers for all other work.
suggestions.monday_update: The Pre-Launch Stack Test and Site/Landing Pages milestones are 31 days overdue as of 2026-08-31, and GA4, Search Console, and IG all read zero — confirming the site is not live. Nacer must sign off on stack test completion and Web must confirm page URLs are indexed before any ad accounts are activated. Success check: GA4 sessions > 0 and a confirmed stack-test pass event logged in the SOW tracker by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Submit LSA verification today if not done — 3–4 week approval window means search ads cannot launch before late September without immediate action.
suggestions.monday_update: LSA Verification was due 2026-07-31 and has no recorded completion; it is 31 days overdue. Google's approval window is 3–4 weeks, meaning every day of delay pushes the ~$5,000/month Google budget further out. The Google Ads lead must submit verification materials today and log the submission timestamp in Monday. Success check: verification status confirmed 'in review' by 2026-09-02.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP daily actions — currently 0 for 3 consecutive days; investigate listing visibility before paid launch adds dependency on it.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 28, 29, and 30 — a confirmed 3-day signal of darkness on the only active channel. Re-check on 2026-09-03; if actions remain at 0, escalate to a GBP reinstatement review before paid ads launch and depend on the listing for call volume.
